name: Guacamole
description: A fresh and simple guacamole recipe made with chilled avocado, lime juice, and minced Spanish onion.

recipeInstructions.text: Mash the chilled avocado in a bowl.
Stir in lime juice and minced Spanish onion until well combined.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

_similar.name: Onion Salad
_similar.description: A simple onion salad marinated in a sweet and tangy dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate the thinly sliced onions with salt, sugar, water, and vinegar overnight.
Drain the marinade well in the morning.
Add mayonnaise (or salad dressing) and celery seed to the drained onions.
Chill until ready to serve.

_similar.keywords: onion salad, marinated onions, sweet and tangy salad

_similar.name: Tortilla Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.

_similar.keywords: tortilla soup, Mexican soup, chicken soup, spicy soup

_similar.name: Wassail
_similar.description: A warm and spicy apple cider drink perfect for the holiday season, flavored with lemon, cinnamon, and pineapple juice.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, heat the apple cider and cinnamon stick to boiling.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in nutmeg, honey, lemon juice, lemon peel, and pineapple juice.
Simmer, uncovered, for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot in mugs and garnish with cinnamon sticks.

_similar.keywords: wassail, apple cider drink, holiday beverage, spiced drink

_similar.name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

_similar.keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Black Bean Salad
_similar.description: A fresh and vibrant salad featuring black beans, salsa, and corn kernels on a bed of romaine lettuce.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped tomato, salsa, and scallions in a bowl.
Stir in the black beans.
Spread shredded romaine lettuce in a serving dish.
Top the lettuce with the bean and salsa mixture.
Microwave the corn kernels on high for 30 seconds.
Distribute the warmed corn over the salad and serve.

_similar.keywords: black bean salad, Mexican salad, fresh corn
